title: pbakaus/impeccable: design rules a coding agent can run locally
friendlyTitle: Impeccable gives a coding agent local rules for interface design
summary: Impeccable is an Apache-2.0 design skill for coding agents: one install, 24 commands, and 62 detector rules for common tells in AI-generated interface code. The deterministic rules run in the CLI and a browser extension with no model and no API key. Setup starts with `npx impeccable install`, then `/impeccable init`, which writes a PRODUCT.md the later commands read. GitHub's daily Rust trending list had it at 533 stars today. The repository has 85,456 stars.

whyItMatters: If your agent's pages keep coming out as the same gradient and nested cards, this is a shared vocabulary for asking it to audit, quiet, or restyle a surface, plus checks you can run without spending tokens. It will not choose your product. The init file is there so the agent stops confusing audience and constraints with a visual mood.
